Vary the composition from post to post so the feed does not repeat -- the SCENE SPECIFICS for THIS post decide the subject. Draw from a range of premium looks; do NOT default to the same person-at-a-desk shot every time. When a person appears they are a confident Black creator, engaged and intentional, never anonymous side profiles. The image should feel like a premium technology documentary and creative studio brand. COMPOSITION FOR TYPOGRAPHY: leave the LOWER-LEFT / lower third of the frame as clean, uncluttered negative space, a dark simple area with no faces, fine detail, or busy elements there, so a branded headline can be composited over it. ADD-ON: transformation world, spatial threshold between private preview and audience view. SCENE SPECIFICS: empty small screening room viewed through a doorway, a bright blue projector beam striking the side wall while the actual central screen remains dark; one unoccupied row of premium black seats, no people, no desks, architectural wide perspective. Action is confined to middle band, calm navy upper-center and empty dark lower third, vertical 9:16. Deep black #000000, navy #050A1A, electric blue #0047FF, tiny warm aisle practicals. This is an audience-delivery metaphor, not actual Tech Thursday footage. Avoid generic startup office, bright corporate lighting, cheap gamer RGB, cluttered composition, cartoon props, excessive sci-fi armor, robots, fake hologram overload, random neon colors, copyrighted franchise references, garbled screen text, random figurines, tripod-mounted monitors, makeshift setups, rendered text, signage lettering, and garbled typography.

reel.sora_prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16, 12 seconds, empty intimate screening room. First beat 0-2s: a vivid electric-blue projector beam visibly hits the wrong wall while the audience screen stays completely black. Transformation 2-7s: camera moves through the doorway from the operator's angle into an audience seat; the projector smoothly realigns, its beam settling onto the central screen as one simple wordless geometric shape becomes visible there. Resolve 7-10s: settle at seated audience eye height with the correct screen now illuminated, then hold 10-12s. Before and after are immediately readable without text. Documentary realism, navy-black room, restrained blue and warm aisle lamps, original projector hum and a single adjustment click, no music quotation. No person at a desk, no faces. Keep overlay band calm and essential action outside top 12% and bottom 20%. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Illustrative delivery-check metaphor, not a recording of the live show.
